fusions.name: Rallying Howl
fusions.desc: A howl that deals 26 resonating damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it lands, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Gang Up
fusions.desc: Nips the target for 5 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It grows 8% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Den Mother
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and 1% more for every 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Faithful Shadow
fusions.desc: A bonded hound follows you and bites enemies within 5 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
